strategy.label: transcription drafted from the report excerpt by the LLM pipeline (reverse-bafu draft)
strategy.note: basis: Tabelle 10.25 'Lueftungsanlage komplett, Sachbilanz fuer ecoinvent', 6th value column (decentral 6 x 120 m3/h, PE ducts, without ground heat exchanger), per ONE COMPLETE INSTALLATION. The BAFU dataset is per m2a, and the excerpt gives neither the energy reference area nor the lifetime, so the amounts below are per installation and are NOT scaled to m2a.; allocation: none stated. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

evidence.source: 2007 - LCI comfort ventilation in dwellings - Haessig.pdf
evidence.note: report sha256 e6613342bceacac1…, text sha256 c62f3cee51644803…

gaps_reported_by_model: SCALING: the table is per complete installation while the dataset's reference unit is 1 m2a. The energy reference area (the report elsewhere uses 165 m2) and the service life are outside this excerpt, so every amount above is too large by that factor - the exchange LIST is right, the LEVEL is not.

No operating electricity for the fans appears in this table; the dataset's includedProcesses mentions 'Electricity for the operation of the system on 12 month per year', which is in Tabelle 5.8/10.29, outside the excerpt.
The 'Erdregisterrohr, PE', 'Aushub Hydraulikbagger' (excavation), 'Wickelfalzrohr DN 400' and its insulation rows are empty in this column, consistent with a system without a ground heat exchanger.
Steel-duct components (Mini Kanal, Bogen 90 degrees, Verbindungsstueck) are empty in this column, consistent with PE ducts.
The influence of the ducts on the building construction is explicitly excluded by the dataset metadata.
